frames.gloss: 既然、由于现在已经……（引出既成事实作为新决定/新情况的依据）
frames.pattern_notes: now that 是固定的双词连词，整存整取，不可拆成 now + that 理解。后接一般现在/现在完成从句表既成事实，主句常是新决定或新情况。没见过的学习者极易按字面读成“现在那个”而卡壳。句首、句中均可出现。

examples.s: ” Most of the people who receive help from the Red Cross are very grateful for the help, and some even want to return the favour and help others now that they themselves have received help.
Now that both of my grandparents have retired from their jobs in the city, how they are going to spend their retirement is an important decision for them.

frames.gloss: 既然、由于（since 表原因而非时间）
frames.pattern_notes: 句首 Since + 从句 + 主句，从句用一般时/过去时、主句用 would 或一般现在表常态，是因果解读的信号。学习者的默认反应是 since = 自从（期待完成体），遇到因果用法会实际读错句子逻辑。本批两例主句均无完成体，歧义真实存在。

examples.s: Since reindeer were always on the move, the Sami would pick up their tents and accompany them.
Since the coastline is so long, each region has its own dishes that are related to the seafood found in its waters.

frames.frame: the + 最高级 + [N] (that) + [主语] + have/has/had ever + [V-ed]
frames.gloss: 某人经历过的最……的……（最高级与 ever+完成体绑定）
frames.pattern_notes: 最高级名词短语后接省略 that 的定语从句，从句内固定用 ever + 完成体。骨架在“最高级 … ever + have/had done”这一跨槽位搭配：学习者常把 ever 当独立副词“曾经”读，或改用一般过去时，导致理解偏差。整存整取查表价值高。

examples.s: Tasmania is the most unforgettable place I have ever been to.
Effect A The chef just began filling our table with the best food we had ever eaten.

candidates.note: If it weren't for [NP], [主句+would]：与现在事实相反的虚拟条件固定句式，误读风险高；但本批仅 1 例，不够重复判据。

example.s: ” If it weren’t for sea animals, we would all starve.

candidates.note: It was [被强调部分] that ... 强调句：it ... that 骨架固定、误读风险高（易读成形式主语）；本批仅 1 例。

example.s: Oliver: And it was the ship that brought you to England.

candidates.note: Upon V-ing, [主句] = 一……就：upon + 动名词为固定搭配，正式语域；本批仅 1 例。

example.s: Upon hearing that she had been awarded the Nobel Prize, she said, “The honour is not just mine.

candidates.note: You mean, [陈述语序]? 口语确认问句：不用倒装、靠升调表疑问，学习者易按一般疑问句规则读错；本批仅 1 例。

example.s: A: Y ou mean, the new police story was fi lmed in five countries?

candidates.note: such [N] that [结果]：已有 so...that 的名词性变体；本批仅此 1 例为 such...that，作变体候选。

example.s: When we were finally rescued, we felt such relief and joy that many of us could not hide our tears.

candidates.note: Unlike [A], [主句]：已有 Like [A],[B] 句首类比的反义变体；本批仅 1 例。

example.s: Unlike most people around the world though, his workplace was in space.

candidates.note: all the time 表抱怨（总是/老是）：两例重复，但为无槽位词块，骨架判据拿不准，故列候选。

example.s: "You watch TV all the time and never help out around the house!

candidates.note: by mistake = 错误地/无意中：两例出现（另一例为练习残句 S02882），但属介词词块、无槽位骨架，且其一语域为题目残句，列候选。

example.s: Boy 1: Hey, did you know that potato chips were invented by mistake?

candidates.note: What does it mean when [从句]?：询问概念含义的固定问句式；仅 1 例且偏课堂提问语域。

example.s: What does it mean when we say that laughter is contagious?

candidates.note: be of great importance = be very important（be of + 抽象名词）：固定结构；本批仅 1 例。

example.s: Sign language is of great importance for people are deaf or have poor hearing.
